title: Grafana Service account token: must be flagged (provider-documented) [legacy tier T1]
summary: Synthetic Grafana Service account token values built to the documented format appear in 6 inputs in CI configuration, container and orchestration configuration, environment files, HTTP headers, SDK and client configuration, and source code. Each input records the exact byte range of the secret.
rationale: A credential that a scanner misses in an ordinary carrier is leaked. Carriers differ in quoting, delimiters and surrounding text, so a hit on one carrier does not show coverage of another.

expectation.rationale: Synthetic value matches the pinned lexical format contract. Provider issuance, payload/checksum validity and liveness are not claimed.
